name: Three independently reusable rolled chart variants
authoring: Native procedural Blender mesh, owner-authorized modeling trial. No Tripo body or prop geometry reused.
owner_override: Export each chart roll separately for reuse; do not fuse into a three-roll bundle.
dimension_contract: Each independent complete roll is 0.600m along X, 0.040m high along Godot Y, 0.040m deep along Godot Z. Base lies at Y=0, origin centred in the footprint. All transforms identity. These are individual-roll targets from the source geometry guide, not the older combined bundle envelope of 0.600 x 0.080 x 0.080m.
geometry: One connected closed solid representing a thick continuous 3.08-turn spiral of paper per roll; actual air gaps, hollow through-core, spiral end faces and a long free cut edge. Three variants differ in rim waviness, slight taper, free-edge orientation and painted wear.

materials.albedo: One 1024x1024 colour-only parchment texture per variant, embedded in each GLB and supplied separately.
materials.notes: All depth comes from geometry and current lighting. Analytic pigment masks add broad ochre stains and sparse colour-only crease marks. Preview images use studio lights and ground shadows; neither is exported or painted into textures.

integration_status: Standalone models only. No repository changes, game placement, inventory changes, colliders, commits or pushes in this trial.
limitations: Static rolled state only; not an animated unrolling sheet.
No printed map content, tie or cord; those are absent from the approved charts sheet.
Three independent rolls total 9168 triangles if all shown; each roll individually is within the 2500-3500 handheld prop target.
Final cabin placement and game shader visual acceptance remain engine work.
verification: Closed manifold connected paper geometry, positive volume, no degenerate faces.
Axial ray confirms unobstructed central bore; radial ray crosses six separated paper surfaces per roll.
GLB dimensions, identity transforms, triangle count, UVs, normals, orthogonal tangents and embedded texture pixel equality.
Independent Godot import confirms dimensions, origin and material/texture loading.
